gloss: respectful viewing (of a temple or shrine)

definitions.gloss: respectful viewing (of a temple or shrine)
definitions.explanation: To view a temple, shrine, or comparable historical or religious site. Humble in origin, framing the visitor's looking as a reverent act rather than ordinary sightseeing.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{九時|くじ}→九時：10980_kuji⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{拝観|はいかん}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This temple can be viewed from nine o'clock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紅葉|もみじ}→紅葉：05387_momiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{拝観|はいかん}⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{混|こ}み⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: During the autumn-leaf season, the temple gets crowded with tourists who want to view it.

notes:
{拝観|はいかん} combines ⟦{拝|おが}む→拝む：00328_ogamu⟧ (to pray to, to bow before) and ⟦{観|かん}→〜観：09847_kan⟧ (viewing). The {拝|はい} frames entry as a reverent act, which is why the word is confined to temples, shrines, and comparable historical sites and does not extend to ordinary sightseeing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {拝観|はいかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to view (a temple or shrine)
- {拝観|はいかん}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to be able to view; to be open for viewing
- {拝観|はいかん}⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧: wishing to view
- ⟦{拝観料|はいかんりょう}→拝観料：07059_haikanryou⟧: the viewing fee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧: an educational visit or tour — neutral, used for factories, schools, and museums; lacks the reverent tone of {拝観|はいかん}.
- ⟦{参拝|さんぱい}→参拝：10634_sanpai⟧: worshipping at a shrine or temple — centers on the act of prayer itself, while {拝観|はいかん} centers on looking at the grounds, buildings, or treasures.
